documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: An earlier inquiry from our manufacturing team requested discovery about duplicate follow-ups. The latest call says the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement. Please clarify the contradictory project information before proposing a meeting.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer's operational friction involves contradictory project information regarding the status of their workflow coordination needs. Specifically, the manufacturing team requested discovery about duplicate follow-ups, but the latest call indicates the project is paused, and the owner disagrees about the requirement. This conflict needs clarification before any further action.

claims.quote: Please clarify the contradictory project information before proposing a meeting.

raw_proposal.draft: We understand that there is conflicting information regarding the status of your project. The manufacturing team previously requested discovery about duplicate follow-ups, but the latest call indicates the project is paused, and there is disagreement about the requirement. To ensure we align with your needs, could you clarify the current status and requirements for your workflow coordination project?
questions: Could you clarify the current status of the project and whether the workflow coordination requirement is still valid?
Are there any specific concerns or disagreements the owner has about the requirement that we should be aware of?
uncertainties: The exact nature of the disagreement between the owner and the manufacturing team about the requirement.
Whether the project is paused indefinitely or temporarily, and if there is a timeline for resuming.
